visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with four people sitting on a grey couch against a plain white wall. In the foreground, two young men sit side-by-side; the one on the left has dyed pink hair and the one on the right has blonde hair, both wearing matching khaki button-down shirts. Behind them, a young woman with dark hair in a green shirt sits on the left, and an older man with glasses wearing a beige jacket sits on the right. They are all clapping their hands in a synchronized rhythm. (2) As the rhythmic game progresses, the camera occasionally cuts to medium close-ups of the participants. The pink-haired man points at the camera with a wide smile, while the blonde-haired man reacts with surprised facial expressions. The lighting is bright and consistent studio-style lighting, casting soft shadows. A small green plant is visible in the background to the right. (3) During a failed round, the pink-haired man waves his hand in a dismissive gesture while laughing heartily. The scene briefly cuts to a stylized meme-style insert featuring a man in a yellow suit dancing, then returns to the group who are now leaning into each other, laughing and gesturing wildly with their hands. (4) The final segment shows the group successfully completing several rounds of the word game. They celebrate by pointing towards the camera and each other, their faces filled with joy and excitement. The camera remains mostly static with slight handheld vibrations, maintaining a focus on the group's energetic physical interactions and synchronized clapping movements.
